origin: Patterns noticed on epoch-9 arch-only candidate pairs (data/evals/kb_claim_pairwise/kb_0008_e9) after trying a handful of simple rules; therefore hypotheses, not findings.
test_data: Fresh dataset instances (new seed range) with one-factor-at-a-time candidate sets from tools/run_controlled_arch_experiment.py. Each set changes exactly one architecture field; optimizer, loss, budget and batch size are shared.

decision_rule.H01a: CONFIRMED if decisive-pair precision >= 0.85 AND dataset-bootstrap 95% lower bound >= 0.70; REFUTED if precision < 0.60; otherwise INCONCLUSIVE.
decision_rule.others: Exploratory: precision and CI are reported, no pass/fail verdict.
